ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: A refuse heap is where discarded filth is piled. Chan masters make it a place for burying pretension and rejected words, yet the same corpus pictures a full-sized golden body appearing on its top and a bright pearl found there; the heap does not itself fix the value of what appears on it.
EvidenceBody: A question in the Complete Collection of the Five Lamps contrasts Yunmen’s threat to beat Shakyamuni with a threat to smother Yunmen on a refuse heap; the recorded reply is thirty blows.
Zhenjing Kewen says ten or five muddy, indiscriminate fellows like Yunmen could be buried in the refuse heap without fault.
Xuedou Chongxian says a full-sized golden body appears atop the refuse heap, then sets the line aside before pressing the case further.

Dongshan Shouchu likens his joy to finding a bright pearl on a refuse heap. Shiyu Mingfang says he cast a worn-out whisk onto such a heap for more than ten years. These opposed predicates keep the literal locale stable.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: The place for refuse becomes a recurrent Chan stage for burial, rejection, and the startling appearance or recovery of what is valued.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: Heap imagery alone does not decide praise or blame: masters bury people and words there, but also locate a golden body or pearl there.

ComparedThings: Burial, discard, a golden body’s appearance, and finding a pearl all take place at the same refuse heap
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Burial, discard, a golden body’s appearance, and finding a pearl all take place at the same refuse heap. Opposite valuations of what is on the heap do not turn the locale into different things.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Refuse, dung, rubbish, bury, golden body, and heap expose the literal site and the corpus’s opposed high-value deployment shapes.

ModifierControls.reason: 糞掃 was checked against 糞掃衣: in this headword it modifies 堆 as a pile of refuse, not the rag-robe compound and not the act of sweeping dung.

FamilyControls.reason: 糞掃堆頭 and 糞掃堆裏 are locative expansions of the same heap; 明珠 and 丈六金身 are occupants or images placed there, not definitions of the heap.
